features.name: nextjs-app project
features.reason: Prism regenerates your app as a node graph (the graph is the app) — it does not run your framework build. Structure, copy, and brand are carried into the regenerated app.
features.detail: Next.js App Router — routes read from app/**/page & route handlers.

features.name: 3 page routes → 3 hubs
features.reason: Each page route becomes a hub in the regenerated Prism app.

features.name: 1 dynamic routes (e.g. /notes/[id])
features.reason: A dynamic route becomes one hub template; the per-item data that fills it comes from a data source you connect (needs-you below).

features.name: 1 layout(s)
features.reason: Shared layouts map onto Prism global slots (header/footer/nav), not arbitrary React layout components.

features.name: 5 React components
features.reason: Your components inform the regenerated layout, but Prism authors scene NODES (3D-native), not your React code verbatim — the graph is the app.

features.name: 7 copy strings (headings, CTAs)
features.reason: Your headings and calls-to-action seed the regenerated text nodes.
features.detail: Your dashboard · Every note, beautifully organized

features.name: Brand palette (#1f6feb, #f97316, #0b1020)
features.reason: Your colours carry into the regenerated app, mapped onto the "Aurora Glass" material direction.

features.name: Typography (Playfair Display, Inter)
features.reason: Your font choices map to the nearest Prism type classification (display/text). Exact webfonts can be wired at ship time.

features.name: Prisma / SQL DB integration
features.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: prisma).

features.name: Stripe integration
features.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: stripe).

features.name: 2 data models (Note, User)
features.reason: Prism does not migrate your database. The models are captured so you can connect your data source; the schema itself stays where it lives.

features.name: 1 API endpoints
features.reason: Server routes are not transplanted (contamination-aware: Prism never runs unverified code). They are listed so you can rebuild them as Prism backend capabilities.
